title: build_manifest.json
description: Provenance stamp shipped beside every distribution of the dataset (GitHub release assets, the Hugging Face dataset, the PyPI package data, the Pages site's docs/data, and the STIX/TAXII/MISP directories). Every count and `taxonomy_versions` is copied from data/stats.json (invariant 6); only `commit`, `built_at`, `built_at_basis` and `dirty` come from the build. Written only in export/release steps, never by `make build`. `built_at` is NOT the wall-clock time of the build: it is the committer date of `commit` (or SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH), so rebuilding a commit is byte-reproducible. Counts: `disputed_count` is a SUBSET of `incident_count` (disputed entries stay counted); `retracted_count` and `unverified_count` are OUTSIDE it (incident_count + retracted_count + unverified_count = rows in data/incidents.json). Never add `disputed_count` to anything.

commit.description: Full git SHA of the source commit.

built_at_basis.description: What `built_at` was taken from. Never the wall clock.

dirty.description: True when a tracked file differed from `commit` at build time (a local build). Release builds are false.

version.description: Dataset version label (stats.json `version`): the plain release version only when the data is exactly that release's; `<release>+main` between cuts (D132).

incident_count.description: Entries that stand (retracted and unverified excluded; disputed included).

unverified_count.description: Entries with status unverified (user ruling D130: no confirmed primary source): not in incident_count. Added after v2.13.0; manifests from v2.13.0 lack it.

disputed_count.description: Entries with status disputed: a subset of incident_count.
